_comment: Transcribed verbatim from the map's POWER legend (three power items, each
with the exact stages it appears in). The game's core power is the magic
shot (grants 2 shots), so every POWER stage marks one heart in that room as
a power-heart. The three lists are kept distinct for possible future
per-item effects; today all three grant the same +2 shots. Stage effects
beyond the shot are undocumented in reachable sources.
